verdicts.decision_note: The client explicitly keeps secondary royalties active as a system sale rule that funds the prize pools, supporting the enabled royalty behavior and its secondary-sales scope.
This is the first target-specific implementation claim for enforced royalties on Base testnet; no concrete royalty transaction is reported, so it remains a claim rather than verification.
The client sets the secondary-sale charge to a flat $10 royalty, changing an implementation-relevant business rule without making prior keys obsolete.

The client specifies ERC-721C and marketplace whitelisting as the contract controls for enforcing the $10 royalty, and message 241 confirms that choice; no existing top-level token-standard key requires removal.
